caption: The drawing shows a brown cast-iron bench with a seat made from lattice-like metalwork and a backrest and arms decorated with a detailed pattern of grapevines, leaves, and grape clusters. The grapevine design forms an open, intricate structure across the back and sides of the bench. The legs of the bench feature additional ornate detailing, including curved and leafy motifs, with the front legs ending in foot-like shapes. The bench is depicted against a plain, light beige background, with no additional objects or scenery present. The colors used are primarily shades of brown for the bench and off-white for the background, producing a clear contrast between the object and its surroundings.
title: Bench in Cemetary Lot
